The document states no capacity at all (no MW, MWp or MWn anywhere), so mw_nominal is null; mw_peak, hectares and turbines are omitted. Municipalities: 'Municipio: La Rinconada (Sevilla)' is the only one printed and hosts the plant; the evacuation infrastructure is not located in the text.
